fato_historico: 1863: American Civil War: Confederate forces evacuate Battery Wagner and Morris Island in South Carolina.

Much like moving away from heavy defenses to seek new, tranquil horizons, you might find it is a good time to release burdens that no longer serve your growth. Consider this a fresh start, focusing on building solid foundations where peace and resilience can finally bloom beautifully.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in the quiet wisdom of choosing where to stand tall.

conselho: Let go of past conflicts and focus your energy on cultivating lasting inner harmony.
